title: The Mystery of the Fortress
subtitle: Secrets Lurk Behind Ancient Fortress Walls
summary: When Byomkesh Bakshi returns to a quiet town for a mysterious new case, he uncovers whispers of a wealthy family's secrets hidden beyond its borders. A seemingly innocent investigation quickly spirals into a web of intrigue, as the fortress and its enigmatic inhabitants reveal clues that defy explanation. Step into this atmospheric mystery where every stone on the old road could hide a truth worth killing for.
